import pandas as pd

def load_data(file_path):
    return pd.read_csv(file_path)

def select_indicators(indicator_descriptions):
    mobility = indicator_descriptions[indicator_descriptions['theme'] == 'mobility']
    population_density = indicator_descriptions[indicator_descriptions['theme'] == 'population_density']
    environment = indicator_descriptions[indicator_descriptions['theme'] == 'environment']
    living_conditions = indicator_descriptions[indicator_descriptions['theme'] == 'living_conditions']
    
    mobility_indicators = [
        ['TT1010V', 'Share of journeys to work by public transport (rail, metro, bus, tram) -%', 'mobility', 'Provides information on the share of public transport in urban mobility.', 'higher_is_better'],
        ['TT1003V', 'Share of journeys to work by car -%', 'mobility', 'Provides information on the share of car usage in urban mobility.', 'lower_is_better'],
        ['TT1006V', 'Share of journeys to work by motor cycle -%', 'mobility', 'Provides information on the share of motor cycle usage in urban mobility.', 'higher_is_better'],
    ]
    population_density_indicators = [
        ['TT1001V', 'Population density - inhabitants per square kilometer', 'population_density', 'Provides information on the population density of urban areas.', 'higher_is_better'],
    ]
    environment_indicators = [
        ['TT1002V', 'CO2 emissions from passenger transport - tons per capita', 'environment', 'Provides information on the CO2 emissions from passenger transport in urban areas.', 'higher_is_better'],
        ['TT1004V', 'Greenhouse gas emissions from transport -%, transport -%, energy -%, waste -%', 'environment', 'Provides information on the greenhouse gas emissions from transport in urban areas.', 'higher_is_better'],
    ]
    living_conditions_indicators = [
        ['TT1005V', 'Proportion of population with access to green spaces -%', 'living_conditions', 'Provides information on the proportion of population with access to green spaces in urban areas.', 'higher_is_better'],
    ]
    
    selected_indicators = mobility_indicators + population_density_indicators + environment_indicators + living_conditions_indicators
    return selected_indicators

def write_selected_indicators(selected_indicators):
    df = pd.DataFrame(selected_indicators, columns=['indicator_id', 'indicator_name', 'theme', 'justification', 'expected_direction'])
    df.to_csv('outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv', index=False, quotechar='"', quoting=1)

def main():
    indicator_descriptions = load_data('inputs/eurostat/indicator_descriptions.csv')
    selected_indicators = select_indicators(indicator_descriptions)
    write_selected_indicators(selected_indicators)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
